A reading of section 2 for TEST-DESIGNER (step 6), no departure: «a non-string → false» is kept strictly — the rule never coerces, so an array ["22.23.4"], a String object and an object whose toString gives the floor are false (probe rows; mutant S03 shows a coercing rule would take them). nodeFloorRefusal shows a version «as given» only when it is a string of the shown shape; a number such as 22.234, null, undefined or an object is shown as «неизвестная версия». A version of exactly 64 shown characters is printed, 65 is not (the border twins).

SAFETY note: to prove that the default argument reads process.versions.node (mutant D01, «the default is a constant», would otherwise pass), the probe set the configurable property process.versions.node to the strings 22.21.1, 22.24.0 and 23.0.0 inside its own process, with a positive control and the descriptor restored (D12–D15) — a version string only, as the design's preload does (F1); no Node was installed or downloaded. Nothing of tools/src but the new module (and copies of it outside the project) was imported; no Pixel Office, hook, team server or real claude was started; SAI_TEAM_REAL_RUNS was never set; the real home's state folder was not touched; no command was denied by the permission check.

Counts for «As built» (AP-143): the built module has 64 lines (section 0 names 54 for the sketch; the difference is comments). It holds exactly one bordered 22.<n>.<n> text (the NODE_FLOOR literal), which is the «module» text among the 9 floor texts NF-01 expects after S6. Until S2 the module has no caller.

A small process slip, for ORCH to judge as a journal record (Q13; nothing of the project was touched): the Write tool turned printable \u escapes of my probe (\u2028, \u2029, \u0400, \uFF12) into raw characters, and a raw U+2028 inside a regex literal is a line end, so the probe's first run ended with a SyntaxError (a red of the instrument, not of the module). Fixed in the probe with explicit character codes (String.fromCharCode, new RegExp from an escaped string) before any result was taken. Lesson: a probe that needs such characters builds them from codes, and its first run is read for an error of its own before its output is trusted (AP-160).
